comment_1.text: Listen for how different people see the same process.

comment_2.text: Now, you will hear three different voices, one after another. Each person will share their own view on what you just heard.
comment_2.source: design.md B-1(3V/4V統合設計Trial、未承認・Trial-only、registryへ書かない)

comment_3.text: You have heard three different ways of experiencing the same situation. Instead of deciding which view is right, let us ask why the situation feels different to each person. Next, we will look more closely at where that difference comes from.
comment_3.source: design.md B-1(3V/4V統合設計Trial、未承認・Trial-only、registryへ書かない)

comment_4.text: So this is not only a question of who is right. It is also a question of what is shaping the situation, and why it feels different for each person.
